senses.gloss: (cmp. צָפַן, צָפָה) [to look up to, look out for,]
to respect; to care for, mind Y. Snh. X, beg. 27ᶜ זהו שאומר ואיני סוֹפְנָהּ … that is he who says, there is a Torah, but I do not mind its authority; Y. Peah I, 16ᵇ סובלה (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 3:14">Tosef. Sot. III, 14</cite> <he>ולא סְפָנוּהוּ וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>סנפוהו</he>, corr. acc.) they minded him not, because he was merely a common soldier (<cite ref="C00391"><he>גּוֹלְיָיר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 33:2">Sifré Deut. 33</cite> (ref. to <he>היום</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:6">Deut. VI, 6</cite>) <he>שלא יהו … שאין אדם סופנה</he> Rashi ed. Berl. a. l. (ed. <he>סופרה</he>, corr. acc.; Ms. 3 <he>צוֹפְנָהּ</he>, v. ed. Fr. note) that they be not in thy eyes like an antiquated ordinance which nobody minds; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 840:1">Yalk. Deut. 840</cite> <he>שאין הכל סוֹפְנִין אותה</he> (not <he>סופגין</he>).

Tosef. Keth. VII, 5 תהא מוטלת ואין כל בריה סופנה (not בריא) she will lie dead and none will care for her (to bury her); Keth. 72ᵃ ואון … סופדה … סופנה (R. Hillel quoted in Sifré l. c., ed. Fr. note צופנה) and none will mourn for her, and some say sof’nah; (Y. ib. VII, 31ᵇ bot. משגחת).—Part. pass. סָפוּן; pl. סְפוּנִים, סְפוּנִין.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20">Ex. R. s. 20</cite> <he>והייתי ס׳ בפניו</he> (some ed. <he>בעיניו</he>) and I enjoyed his respect. Mekh. B’shall., Vayass‘a, s. 2 <he>וכי מה אנו ס׳ שאתם וכ׳</he> what is our distinction, that you murmur against us?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 258:8">Yalk. Ex. 258</cite>. Tanḥ. Vayesh. 3 <he>אתה עושה … כאלו הוא ס׳</he> thou wouldst treat the idolater as if he (his idolatry) was respected.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 258:8">Ib.</cite> <he>אינן ס׳ לכלום</he> are regarded as nothing (before God); a. e.—[

senses.gloss: (b. h.) to provide, lay up; v. next w.]
